articles.title: The Paradox of Burnout
articles.highlight: 许多人将这类工作视为一种召唤，而不仅仅是职业。
articles.summary: 文章通过对比两类工作——一类拥有声望、趣味与优厚待遇，常被当作“使命”；另一类只是谋生手段——揭示一个悖论：越是被视为“召唤”的工作，可能越容易引发倦怠。原因在于自我认同过度绑定工作，难以抽离。值得一读，因为它提醒我们重新审视工作与幸福的关系。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：对“使命型”工作要保持警惕，主动设定工作与生活的边界，避免因过度投入而陷入倦怠。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Consider two different kinds of jobs: In the first job, there is prestige, interest and, in many instances, good pay and benefits. Many people see this line of work as not merely a job, but a calling. In the second job, work is simply work.

en.highlight: Many people see this line of work as not merely a job, but a calling.
en.summary: The article contrasts two kinds of jobs—one with prestige, interest, and good pay that is often seen as a calling, and another that is merely work—to reveal a paradox: jobs framed as callings may actually lead to more burnout because identity becomes too tied to work. It is worth reading because it prompts us to rethink the relationship between work and well-being.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: be wary of 'calling' jobs, proactively set boundaries between work and life, and avoid burnout from overcommitment.

articles.title: Leonard Cohen on the Antidote to Anger and the Meaning of Resistance
articles.highlight: 在罕见的无助与不确定中，我们渴望兜售确定性的权威，把拳头称为援手。
articles.summary: 文章指出，愤怒是对无助感最常见也最具腐蚀性的反应，既发生在私人生活也发生在政治生活中。在充满不确定性的时代，人们容易渴望一个兜售确定性的权威人物，将拳头伪装成援手。科恩的思考提醒我们审视这种原始冲动，是理解个人情绪与政治心理的重要读物。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：面对无助时愤怒是本能，但更要警惕把确定性权威当作解药的危险。真正的抵抗或许始于直面不确定，而非屈从于宣称能拯救我们的力量。
articles.sourceExcerpt: One of the commonest and most corrosive human reflexes is to react to helplessness with anger. We do it in our personal lives and we do it in our political lives. We are living through a time of uncommon helplessness and uncertainty, touching every aspect of our lives, and in such times another reflex is the longing for an authority figure selling certainty, claiming the fist to be a helping hand.

en.highlight: We live through a time of uncommon helplessness and uncertainty, longing for an authority figure selling certainty, claiming the fist to be a helping hand.
en.summary: The article observes that anger is a common and corrosive response to helplessness, in both personal and political life. In uncertain times, we tend to long for an authority figure who sells certainty, offering a fist disguised as a helping hand. en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: anger is instinctive when we feel helpless, but be wary of the temptation to treat certainty-selling authority as the cure. Resistance may begin with enduring uncertainty rather than submitting to those who claim to save us.

zh.highlight: VibeCurb 向 AI 工作流注入品味，阻止智能体生成无聊、千篇一律的 AI 味内容。
zh.summary: 该库介绍 VibeCurb，一个通过在 AI 工作流中注入品味来阻止智能体生成单调、AI 味内容的工具。项目在 GitHub 上获得 813 星且近期有活跃更新，表明社区对其解决 AI 输出同质化问题的关注，值得开发者参考。
zh.failureAnalysis: 品味本身是主观的，难以量化验证，用户可能不认同“无趣”的判定，导致需求定义模糊。作为轻量工具，它依赖额外的启发式规则或模型调用，可能增加延迟和成本，且容易被 GPT 等模型自带的风格控制功能取代。若非独立分发，其商业化和持续维护难度较高。

en.highlight: Injects taste into AI workflows to stop agents from generating boring, AI slop.
en.summary: This repository presents VibeCurb, a tool that injects taste into AI workflows to prevent agents from producing boring, generic AI slop. With 813 stars and recent active updates, it reflects growing community interest in the problem of homogeneous AI outputs, making it worth reading for developers building agentic systems.
en.failureAnalysis: Taste is subjective and hard to measure, so the product's core value proposition is difficult to validate. The tool likely adds latency or cost through extra heuristics or model calls, and may be displaced by built-in style controls from model providers.
en.title: VibeCurb: Injecting Taste into AI Workflows to Stop AI Slop
